propositions: Mutation testing gate should enforce behavioral contracts using three enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with explicit per-shard configuration in a manifest file rather than stale whole-file counts
Gate must support phased shard promotion starting at advisory mode and advancing to ratchet or strict only after evidence gathering and pilot runs demonstrate stability
Fresh isolated base/head archives must be evaluated without persisted mutation verdict cache, with per-mutant timeout derived from test runtime multiplied by pinned constants
Selector must map changed source, test, and support files to their corresponding shards, preserving both sides of renames and reporting unmatched tests
Workflow must create per-shard matrix jobs with independent 30-minute runtime caps, always-published artifacts, and diagnostic-only reruns that cannot turn failures green
